question: Paramvir Chakra, Ashok Chakra and Vir Chakra are presented during the celebration of which day?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Republic Day.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Param Vir Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, and Vir Chakra**, which are among **India's highest military honours**, are usually presented during the **Republic Day celebrations.**
 
• Republic Day, which is celebrated on **January 26 every year**, marks the day on which the **Constitution of India came into effect**, establishing India as a republic.
 
• The awards are **presented by the President of India**. It's during the Republic Day parade, that bravery and gallantry awards for military personnel are generally announced.
 
• It's important to note that the **Ashoka Chakra can be awarded to military as well as civilian personnel and can be awarded posthumously.**

**​** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Independence Day:**

 
 
• Independence Day is celebrated in India on **August 15** every year, marking the **country's independence from British rule in 1947.**
 
• The Prime Minister of India **hoists the Indian flag at the Red Fort in Delhi** and delivers a speech addressing the nation.
 
• The day is marked with various** cultural and patriotic events,** but military awards are not typically presented on this day.
 
 
 
• **Gandhi Jayanti:**
 
 
• Gandhi Jayanti is celebrated on** October 2** each year to **honour the birth of Mahatma Gandhi,** fondly known as the **"Father of the Nation".**
 
• This day is marked by prayer services and tributes across India, including **at Raj Ghat, Mahatma Gandhi's memorial in New Delhi.**
 
• Events like art **exhibitions and essay competitions** are also held, but military awards are not presented on this day.
 
 
 
• **Indian Air Force Day:**
 
 
• Indian Air Force Day is celebrated on **October 8** each year to mark the **foundation of the Air Force in India.**
 
• This day is typically marked by **air displays and parades **at various Air Force Stations in India.
 
• While recognition and awards specific to the air force may be distributed, the highest military honours like the Param Vir Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, and Vir Chakra are not typically presented on this day.
